description:
Front Garden
T001-Oak
Crown reduction of height and spread by up to 2 metres in branch length. Height being reduced from 10 metres to 8 metres, and canopy spread from 8 metres to 6 metres.
ALL ITEMS INCLUDING REMOVING ARISING DEBRIS, LEAVING SITE CLEAN AND TIDY.

G1 is located in the back garden, see map attached.
The works are part of a regular maintenance programme to retain the tree at a suitable size for their location.
The proposed works would not reduce the amenity value of the tree and will allow sustainable tree management in the long term.
decision_conditions: The specification is not suitable and therefore needs to be confirmed. The specification needs to be measurable and quantifiable so that we can understand the amount that is to be removed in meters. We need to know the amount to be removed and the remaining crown size. E.g. 2m crown reduction in width and 2m reduction in height, leaving a canopy spread of 3m and height of 5m.
